figure_label.rationale: Single-patient timeline graphic of the index patient course (diagnoses, treatments, response labels) with the patient own CT and stained tissue images embedded; the dominant content is a patient-data timeline chart rather than a single imaging study.
figure_label.override_reason: Default rule microscopy reflects only the embedded stained images; the whole graphic is a patient-data timeline combining CT, microscopy and treatment bars.
